# The modules of the carried interpreter (issue #677), compared by python_module_set.py on every
# platform: every module of the standard library the interpreter finds, then the bundled
# packages with their versions. A name alone is on Linux, macOS and Windows; a name followed by
# platforms is on those only (a module CPython itself limits to them).
#
# Written from the script's own output on the three platforms (run without
# BLOOM_PYTHON_MODULE_SET). A module that appears or disappears changes this file: say why in
# the commit that changes it.
